items.title: Bill Huntington and Charlie Suhor Interview, 1992-04-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'm Bruce Rayburn and we're going to be talking to two New Orleans musicians, Bill Huntington and Charles Suhor.

ctx.x: Okay, we're at the Hogan Jazz Archive and it is April 6, 1992. I'm Bruce Rayburn and we're going to be talking to two New Orleans musicians, Bill Huntington and Charles Suhor. And so why don't we begin with Mr. Huntington and you could give us your name for voice check for the record, date of birth, place of birth and then Mr. Suhor.
My name is Bill Huntington. I was born October 2, 1938 at Turo Infirmary in New Orleans.
